_doc: PLANTEUR class map. Maps the 26-class source label id to the 8 trained classes; every excluded crop -> 255 (void), masked out of loss and metrics. Background(0) is genuine non-agricultural land and stays a real trained class. Void covers 92,145 px (0.20% of pixels) in 385 patches; void fields are not parcel instances.
void_in_trainer: Void is 255 on disk. Metric code handles 255 directly. A trainer that allocates one output channel per class cannot represent it (e.g. UTAE-PaPs train_panoptic.py, whose --out_conv sizes the head by num_classes): remap 255 -> 8 and use num_classes 9, void_label 8. The eight trained class ids are unchanged.
